event.title: A Convoy
event.text:
A transmission from The Colony Ship reaches you as your squad crosses into another people's space.
"We are not the only colony ship running from this. No single people can make the crossing alone, but a convoy might: each race's ship escorting the next. Ask them. Start with the ones who have already lost their homes."

choice.text: We'll ask them.

outcome.text: Your squad carries a new offer with it: a place in the convoy, for any people who will fly beside the others.

event.title: The Azurethea and the Convoy
event.text: An Azurethea elder listens to the offer of a place in the convoy without interrupting.

choice.text: Offer their refugees passage in the convoy.

outcome.text: "We have nowhere left to tend. We will fly beside you." The Azurethea pledge their colony ship to the convoy.

choice.text: Let {crew} promise the convoy's shields will cover them.

outcome.text: {crew} speaks softly of flying beside them. The elder bows. The Azurethea pledge to the convoy.

choice.text: Let {crew} offer to keep their people's records.

outcome.text: "We, The Senti-, will remember every one of you." The elder agrees. The Azurethea pledge to the convoy.

choice.text: Ask them to leave a home that is still whole.

outcome.text: "Our gardens still grow. Ask us again when they do not."

choice.text: Leave them be.

event.title: The Tentauri and the Convoy
event.text: Two Tentauri answer your hail, their voices in step. "A convoy. Many ships, flying as one. Show us that you can fly as one."

choice.text: Fly a joint operation with them.

outcome.text: You cross the cluster beside them, shields overlapping. At the far side they answer: the Tentauri pledge to the convoy.
Raiders find you halfway across. The Tentauri hold beside you, and pledge to the convoy when it is over.

choice.text: Let {crew} answer for the Azurethea already in the convoy.

outcome.text: {crew} speaks of the gardens the convoy will carry. The Tentauri pledge to it.

choice.text: Ask them to leave a home that is still whole.

outcome.text: "We are whole here. We do not need to fly as one yet."

choice.text: Leave them be.

event.title: The Mecha and the Convoy
event.text: A Mecha yard boss hears the offer and smiles. "A convoy. And what do the Mecha gain by guarding everyone else's ships?"

choice.text: Pay them to join.

outcome.text: "Now it is a contract." The Mecha pledge to the convoy, for as long as it profits them.

choice.text: Let {crew} show them what they gain.

outcome.text: {crew} lays out the numbers in clipped Mecha code: every ship in the convoy is a customer. The Mecha pledge to it.

choice.text: Show them how many have already joined.

outcome.text: The yard boss counts the pledges twice. "Nobody leaves the Mecha behind at a profit." They pledge to the convoy.

choice.text: Walk away.

event.title: The Senti and the Convoy
event.text: A Senti archive station hails you, its light lines bright. "We, The Senti-, have recorded your offer. A convoy is a record that moves."

choice.text: Offer the convoy's records for them to keep.

outcome.text: "Every people in it, kept. We, The Senti-, will fly with the convoy." The Senti pledge to it.

choice.text: Ask them only to keep the convoy's records.

outcome.text: "We, The Senti-, will not fly beside the living. We will keep what you are." The Senti pledge their archive to the convoy.

choice.text: Let {crew} link with the station.

outcome.text: {crew} exchanges a single burst of data with the station. The Senti pledge to the convoy.

choice.text: Not now.

event.title: The Lykario and the Convoy
event.text: A Lykario pack leader laughs at the offer. "Ride in a convoy? No. But a convoy draws prey, and someone has to hunt for it. Show us you are worth hunting beside."

choice.text: Accept a fair hunt against them.

outcome.text: "Good!" The pack comes for you, and it is not playing.

choice.text: Let {crew} vouch for your squad.

outcome.text: {crew} tells the hunt as it happened. The pack leader grins. The Lykario pledge to hunt for the convoy.

choice.text: Let {crew} offer a contract: escort pay.

outcome.text: {crew} talks pay, GATOS style. The Lykario pledge to hunt for the convoy, and take the first payment now.

choice.text: Move on.

event.title: The Malphen and the Convoy
event.text: A Malphen ship drifts across your path, silent. No race takes the Malphen in, and nothing it does suggests it wants a place in the convoy. But it could let the convoy pass.

choice.text: Jettison matter for it to feed on.

outcome.text: The ship gathers every scrap, slowly, and turns away. It will let the convoy pass. That is as close to a pledge as the Malphen come.

choice.text: Leave it.

event.title: The GATOS and the Convoy
event.text: A GATOS hub answers your hail.

choice.text: Ask them to join.

outcome.text: "We're already in it."

event.title: The Ones Who Refused
event.text:
The rim is here, and behind you the convoy is forming: every people that pledged. Ahead, across the way out, hang the ships of the ones who refused, or were never asked.
"There is room on that path for one convoy," their leader says. "It will not be yours."
The ships of your allies drop out of their jumps beside you.

choice.text: Tell them there is still room in the convoy.

outcome.text: Nobody answers. Their weapons come online.

choice.text: No more talking.

outcome.text: Your squad's weapons come online, and your allies' with them.

event.title: The Rogue
event.text:
The rim is here, and every people in the galaxy that could be asked has pledged to the convoy. For a moment the way out is empty.
Then something vast and living uncoils across it: a Malphen ship that follows no pledge, grown huge on everything the collapse left behind.
The ships of your allies drop out of their jumps beside you.

choice.text: Clear the way.

outcome.text: It does not hail you. It never would.
